color-named.message: Named colour: use a theme token (`var(--token)`, `var(--color-white)`, `var(--color-black)`). Raw colours live only in the theme stylesheets (DESIGN.md, Colour Discipline).

color-no-hex.message: Raw hex colour: use a theme token (`var(--token)`). Raw colours live only in the theme stylesheets (DESIGN.md, Colour Discipline).

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: conventions-ux (Interactions & Animations): never transition `all` or a layout property; layout motion forces a recalculation on every frame. Found "%s: %s".

function-disallowed-list.message: Raw colour function: use a theme token, or `color-mix()` over tokens. Raw colours live only in the theme stylesheets (DESIGN.md, Colour Discipline).

rule-selector-property-disallowed-list.message: conventions-ux (Interactions & Animations): animate transform and opacity only. The `%s` frame animates `%s`, which forces a layout recalc on every frame; use scale/translate instead.

media-feature-name-value-allowed-list.message: conventions-ux (Interactions & Animations): keep touch reveals on the `pointer-coarse` query, not `hover: none`. Found "(%s: %s)".

unit-disallowed-list.message: conventions-ux (Viewport & Responsive): `vh` resolves against the largest viewport and ignores mobile browser chrome. Use `dvh`, or `svh` for a length that must not move while the toolbar collapses.
